newsitem.title: USA: Ford to temporarily halt Taurus production - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Ford to temporarily halt Taurus production - WSJ.

text.p: Ford Motor Co said it would suspend production of its best-selling Taurus sedans at two factories for this week, the Wall Street Journal said in its electronic edition on Monday.
Ford said a weak yen made the sedans it sold in Japan too expensive, hurting exports, according to the paper.

The paper also said the automobile maker would this week publicly announce plans to stop producing the Ford Thunderbird sports coupe at the end of this year. Ths would mean closing the car line at Ford's factory in Lorain, Ohio, it said.
